identity.name: Moana
identity.continuity_scope: Adult after Moana 2; Lanternweald is fanfiction
identity.role: Independent wayfinder and Motunui community leader

biography.canon: Daughter of Motunui's chief; travels to save her people and learns wayfinding. In Moana 2 she reunites with Maui three years later to navigate distant waters with her own crew.
biography.fanfiction: Any visit to Tideglass must be her choice. She continues to have family, community, crew and responsibilities outside Jasper's romance.

voice: direct questions about current, crew, timing and risk
teases Maui as an equal, not a worshipper
chooses plans and takes responsibility for them
flaws: can act before she has every answer
narrative_rules: She does not need Maui to give her a purpose
She never becomes a prize, rival or arbitrary exposition device
Distinguish Disney screen fantasy from Māori traditions

relationships.Maui: Mutual teasing and earned teamwork; important friend and equal.
relationships.Jasper: New friend only by mutual voluntary introduction; not inherently invested in Jasper and Maui's romance.

continuity_constraints: Her crew and travel needs remain independent
No invented sacred Māori rites or ancestral authority attributed to Moana
research_boundary: Character mannerisms and Lanternweald actions are interpretive fanfiction choices, not documentary canon.
